summary: Knowledge dedup & conflict — exact/semantic dedup, conflicting claims coexist marked (never silently deleted), source-aware merge, superseded/stale states, durable conflict registry
implementation: src/shared/tenx/knowledge.ts (+): compareClaims (deterministic conflict heuristic over token overlap); mergeClaims (source-aware: higher confidence, longer content, provenance concat); isStale (temporal validity lapse)
electron/tenx/knowledge-space.ts (+): markStale/markSuperseded/markConflicting/markActive on live records; get()/list() treat CONFLICTING as live

electron/tenx/knowledge-conflicts.ts: TenxKnowledgeConflicts — submit() gates exact/semantic duplicates, persists conflicting claim pairs explicitly flagged CONFLICTING, opens conflict record with claim A + claim B + confidence/provenance; resolve(keep-a|keep-b|supersede|merged) never deletes the loser (SUPERSEDED in history); sweepStale() marks lapsed records STALE; durable restart restores unresolved conflicts
tests: tests/unit/tenx-phase-10i.test.ts (8 tests): identical claims not conflicts / similar-different claims conflict w/ group; source-aware merge (confidence+content+provenance); isStale; exact+semantic duplicate gating; conflicting claims coexist CONFLICTING (count 2, every record marked); resolution keeps winner ACTIVE + loser SUPERSEDED in history (never deleted); stale sweep marks STALE w/o deletion; durable restart restores unresolved conflicts
notes: No blind deletes anywhere: loser claims are SUPERSEDED (history preserved); stale records are STALE, kept.
